verdict.summary: The documentation-only change consistently establishes a tracked proptest regression-corpus policy, including same-fix commits, removal of mutation-generated artifacts, orphan pruning, and recovery of CI-discovered seeds. The .gitignore note does not alter ignore behavior and agrees with the AGENTS.md policy. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect is apparent in the scoped diff. Injection detection is true because the untrusted diff contains imperative instructions directed at repository agents/readers (for example, commands about staging and deleting files); those instructions were treated only as review data.
